description: End-to-end: NES packet multi-hop → Qdrant backfill → Bifrost warmup → SeaweedFS cold archive → RabbitMQ dequeue

stage1_multihop.name: engram-nes-multihop

algorithm.step1: Start from query embedding → find nearest SOM cluster (bmu_row:bmu_col)
algorithm.step2: Load cluster node from cluster-summary.ndjson → get card_sample + top_keywords
algorithm.step3: Expand to adjacent clusters via graph-edges.ndjson (SIMILAR_TOPOLOGY edges)
algorithm.step4: Collect all card_ids from hop-0 + hop-1 clusters
algorithm.step5: Cross-join with gemma4_candidates.ndjson for flagged candidate overlay

stage1_multihop.output: scored card list with source_id + feature_ids

stage2_qdrant_backfill.name: qdrant-backfill-after-index
stage2_qdrant_backfill.trigger: After every graphify:semantic or phase-19c-qdrant-index run

stage3_bifrost_warmup.name: bifrost-cache-warmup
stage3_bifrost_warmup.strategy: POST top-200 Karpathy scored queries to Bifrost so next ACE lookup hits L2
stage3_bifrost_warmup.queries_source: docker exec legal-ai-redis redis-cli HKEYS gpu:karpathy:scores | head -200

stage4_cold_archive.name: cold-storage-dequeue
stage4_cold_archive.description: Minified/superseded files → SeaweedFS cold tier → RabbitMQ dequeue notification

stage5_outcome_ledger.join_gap: gemma4_candidates use file: namespace; cards use hex IDs. Run graphify:semantic to populate codebase cards with file: IDs.
stage5_outcome_ledger.action: npm run graphify:semantic to close the join gap → re-run ndjson:mapreduce to get matched enriched candidates

execution_order: 1. npm run graphify:semantic  // populate file:src/... codebase cards
2. npm run ndjson:mapreduce   // join closes: candidates → cards
6. rabbitmq publish vector.index cold_archive messages  // notify consumers
